effect_description_eng: [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Jamming＞ (This Digimon can't be deleted in battles against Security Digimon.) and ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Trash the top digivolution card of 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
